# Small Business Operations Overview

## Overview
This dashboard gives Coastal Ventures LLC a clear picture of daily operational health, team workload, and project progress. It is designed for small business owners and team leads who need a simple, unified view of active tasks, capacity, and project status without unnecessary complexity.

## Key Metrics
- Active Work Items: 34
- Capacity Utilization: 82.0%
- Tasks Completed (MTD): 47
- Team Size: 12
- Overdue Items: 5

## Insights
- Capacity utilization at 82% is approaching upper limits; consider redistributing 3 open items to balance team load
- 5 overdue items warrant immediate triage, with 2 linked to the Website Redesign project
- Month-to-date task completion of 47 is on track with the rolling 30-day average of 45
